sources.title: Cars Computer Vision Datasets and Models - Roboflow
sources.snippet: Roboflow hosts the world's biggest set of open-source car datasets and pre-trained computer vision models. The category includes images of cars from around the world, curated and annotated by the Roboflow Community. These projects can help you get started with things like object speed calculation, object tracking, autonomous vehicles, and smart-city transportation innovations.
